title: pledge
_what: ⛔ SNG-653 · SNG-658 §2 — SOMEBODY SAID, ALOUD IN A SCENE, THAT THEY WOULD COME FOR YOU. ⚠️ A PLEDGE IS NOT A BOND STAGE: two people can be committed without this promise and can make this promise without being committed. Required is taken from `recordPledge`.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

day.description: the day it was said. ⚠️ A second saying does not erase the first day.

mutual.description: whether the character promised back — a second fact about the same scene, and why the screen can say who you have promised to go for.

words.description: the GM's own account of what was said, kept verbatim so the record reads as the scene did.

source.description: play · author — where the promise came from.

released.description: set when it is taken back — spoken out loud in a scene, never quietly.

releasedDay.description: the day it was taken back.
